And the LORD spoke to Moses, saying,
Speak to the sons of Israel! saying, All fat of oxen and sheep and goats you shall not eat!
And the fat of decaying flesh, and that taken by wild beasts shall be appointed for all work, but for food it shall not be eaten.
Every one eating fat off the cattle, of which he will bring from them as a yield offering; to the LORD, [[2]shall be destroyed ; [1]that soul] from ; its people.
All blood you shall not eat in all ; of your house, of either the cattle or; of the birds.
Every soul which ever should eat blood, [[2]shall be destroyed ; [1]that soul] from ; its people.

And to the sons of Israel you shall speak, saying, The one offering a sacrifice ; of his peace offerings; to the LORD, he shall bring ; his gift to the LORD; of the sacrifice ; of his deliverance offering.
; His own hands shall bring the yield offerings; to the LORD; the fat ; upon the breast, and the lobe, the one upon the liver, he shall bring them so as to place a gift before the LORD.
And [[3]shall offer [1]the [2]priest] the fat upon the altar. And [[3]shall be [1]the [2]breast] Aaron's and ; his sons.

For the breast of the increase offering; and the shoulder of the cut-away portion I have taken from the sons of Israel from the sacrifices ; of your deliverance offering, and I gave them to Aaron to the priest and to; his sons, [[2]law [1]an eternal] for the sons of Israel.
This is the anointing of Aaron, and the anointing ; of his sons, of their portion; of the yield offerings; of the LORD, in which day he brought them ; to officiate as priest to the LORD;
in so far as the LORD gave charge to give to them in which day he anointed them from the sons of Israel, [[2]law [1]an eternal] unto ; their generations.
This is the law of the whole burnt-offerings, and of sacrifice, and for a sin offering, and of the trespass offering, and of the consecration, and of the sacrifice ; of deliverance offering,
in which manner the LORD gave charge to; Moses on ; mount Sinai, in which day he gave charge to the sons of Israel to bring ; their gift offerings; before the LORD; in the wilderness of Sinai.
